deviation_mechanism: The observed oscillation stems from the dynamic interplay between intrinsic photonic performance and the imposed quadratic regularization. Initial perturbations successfully sampled off-quarter-wave configurations that boosted the raw target score to 0.9027. However, the explicit quadratic penalty term penalizes the resulting asymmetry/thickness deviation, creating a steep regularization gradient that pulls the optimizer back toward the constrained quarter-wave manifold, driving the score down to 0.7772. This competition prevents simple monotonic convergence, manifesting as the observed volatile trajectory rather than a flat or steadily decreasing curve.
